description.value: Western Foods is a family-owned, full-service supermarket that has served the Sooke community since 1974, with a second Sooke location added in 1995. Located in the Evergreen Centre, the store carries a broad range of organic produce, gluten-free products, and health-conscious alternatives alongside conventional groceries. The in-house deli prepares fresh hot foods daily — including rotisserie and fried chicken, ready-to-eat snacks, and custom party trays — making it a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through Sooke.
